prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most change types, with only sign-in hints, finish new screens, adoption redesigns, path choice hints, and home redesigns having at least 2 tests.
Sign-in hints, finish new screens, and path choice hints were helpful as each kind included at least one winning test.
Adoption redesigns and home redesigns did not work, showing no clear effect or negative results across multiple tests.
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.
Predictions were significantly too low for unexpected wins like path choice hints (-1.0% predicted vs +4.7% actual) and sign-in reordering (+1.5% predicted vs +6.7% actual).

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Carousel Selection Redesign: Redesigns the friend selection step into a smooth carousel layout to make browsing and picking a pet companion visual and straightforward. (why: Adoption has a heavy drop-off (69.8% completion rate with median time of 89s and mean of 1017s), showing friction during pet choice.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Interaction Shortcuts Screen: Adds a dedicated summary screen after home intro showing basic desktop controls (drag, right-click menu, double-click chat). (why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Split Comparison Layout: Redesigns the path choice screen using a side-by-side split layout contrasting quick ready-made pets with custom AI pet generation. (why: Path selection mean time is 514s (vs median 8s), suggesting some users get stuck deciding between paths.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Readiness System Check Info: Adds troubleshooting wait info to the waiting screen explaining background rendering and desktop permission checks. (why: Support logged 3 emails regarding pets not displaying on desktop or app failing to open properly during launch.)
4: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Delay Post Desktop Waiting Reorder: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after the rendering waiting stage right before home intro. (why: Lessons show sign-in reordering was a strong unexpected win (+6.7% actual), and placing sign-in after pet render build-up increases commitment.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Framing Clarity Hint: Adds explicit photo upload framing instructions on the upload photo screen to ensure optimal AI pet rendering. (why: Support received 3 emails where custom pet generation failed or pet output looked distorted due to bad input photos.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Story Welcome Setup Duration Copy: Updates the story welcome headline and copy to explicitly set expectations that onboarding takes under two minutes. (why: High mean completion times across all initial steps indicate user hesitation early in the funnel.)
7: [finish, layout] Home Intro Split Command Guide Layout: Changes the home intro layout to a split view displaying pet welcome visuals alongside interactive command previews. (why: Finish completion drops to 73.1% with long mean times (5815s) and user post-onboarding interaction confusion.)
8: [home, notification] Waiting Completion Desktop Audio & Visual Notification: Enables a desktop notification flag and completion sound hint on the waiting screen when rendering finishes. (why: Home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, indicating users switch windows while waiting and forget to return.)
